meta.title: Ring Cover
meta.description: That so called escape is just moving from a small cage to a larger one.

units.rawText: Underground, Copley Sector.
units.displayText: Underground, Copley Sector.

spans.text: Underground, Copley Sector.

units.rawText: Time always seems to pass exceptionally slowly in this dark and oppressive environment.
units.displayText: Time always seems to pass exceptionally slowly in this dark and oppressive environment.

spans.text: Time always seems to pass exceptionally slowly in this dark and oppressive environment.

units.rawText: A door squeaks as it is pushed open. A ray of cold, clear light briefly illuminates this prison in the depths of a cave.
units.displayText: A door squeaks as it is pushed open. A ray of cold, clear light briefly illuminates this prison in the depths of a cave.

spans.text: A door squeaks as it is pushed open. A ray of cold, clear light briefly illuminates this prison in the depths of a cave.

units.rawText:
Taranum studies the monster in the darkness, her face devoid of expression.
The Doll part of the creature is working on chewing up something. It is surrounded by fat tentacles, giving it the appearance of a curled up, writhing ball.
units.displayText:
Taranum studies the monster in the darkness, her face devoid of expression.
The Doll part of the creature is working on chewing up something. It is surrounded by fat tentacles, giving it the appearance of a curled up, writhing ball.

spans.text:
Taranum studies the monster in the darkness, her face devoid of expression.

units.rawText: Taranum glimpses the corpse crushed under the tentacles and reflexively averts her eyes. Several seconds later, she slowly opens her mouth to speak.
units.displayText: Taranum glimpses the corpse crushed under the tentacles and reflexively averts her eyes. Several seconds later, she slowly opens her mouth to speak.

spans.text: Taranum glimpses the corpse crushed under the tentacles and reflexively averts her eyes. Several seconds later, she slowly opens her mouth to speak.

units.rawText: [Feeding complete. Proceeding with the next phase of the procedure.]
units.displayText: [Feeding complete. Proceeding with the next phase of the procedure.]

spans.text: [Feeding complete. Proceeding with the next phase of the procedure.]

units.rawText: Hearing the voice, the meatball quivers and timidly unfurls herself.
units.displayText: Hearing the voice, the meatball quivers and timidly unfurls herself.

spans.text: Hearing the voice, the meatball quivers and timidly unfurls herself.

units.rawText: Taranum sees a girl's frightened face before her.
units.displayText: Taranum sees a girl's frightened face before her.

spans.text: Taranum sees a girl's frightened face before her.

units.rawText: [Subject has completed nutrient intake.]
units.displayText: [Subject has completed nutrient intake.]

spans.text: [Subject has completed nutrient intake.]

units.rawText: [Now preparing to carry out the regularly-scheduled experiment.]
units.displayText: [Now preparing to carry out the regularly-scheduled experiment.]

spans.text: [Now preparing to carry out the regularly-scheduled experiment.]

units.rawText: Taranum walks up to Demiurge, still on guard. Surprisingly enough, Demiurge does not attack her with her tentacles like usual. Instead, she continues to cower in the corner.
units.displayText: Taranum walks up to Demiurge, still on guard. Surprisingly enough, Demiurge does not attack her with her tentacles like usual. Instead, she continues to cower in the corner.

spans.text: Taranum walks up to Demiurge, still on guard. Surprisingly enough, Demiurge does not attack her with her tentacles like usual. Instead, she continues to cower in the corner.

units.rawText: [...Activating binding program.]
units.displayText: [...Activating binding program.]

spans.text: [...Activating binding program.]

units.rawText: She presses the button and mechanical arms spring out of the operating slab that has been disguised as a piece of rock. They seize Demiurge's tentacles in a tight grip.
units.displayText: She presses the button and mechanical arms spring out of the operating slab that has been disguised as a piece of rock. They seize Demiurge's tentacles in a tight grip.

spans.text: She presses the button and mechanical arms spring out of the operating slab that has been disguised as a piece of rock. They seize Demiurge's tentacles in a tight grip.

units.rawText: Demiurge struggles weakly.
units.displayText: Demiurge struggles weakly.

spans.text: Demiurge struggles weakly.

units.rawText: Beginning dissection.
units.displayText: Beginning dissection.

spans.text: Beginning dissection.

units.rawText: She operates her instruments and traces one incision line after another onto Demiurge's body.
units.displayText: She operates her instruments and traces one incision line after another onto Demiurge's body.

spans.text: She operates her instruments and traces one incision line after another onto Demiurge's body.

units.rawText: After that, many laser knives automatically emerge and begin to cut a portion of Demiurge's body into pieces.
units.displayText: After that, many laser knives automatically emerge and begin to cut a portion of Demiurge's body into pieces.

spans.text: After that, many laser knives automatically emerge and begin to cut a portion of Demiurge's body into pieces.

units.rawText: Demiurge's struggles seem less vehement than usual. Taranum soon succeeds in cutting off her tentacles.
units.displayText: Demiurge's struggles seem less vehement than usual. Taranum soon succeeds in cutting off her tentacles.

spans.text: Demiurge's struggles seem less vehement than usual. Taranum soon succeeds in cutting off her tentacles.

units.rawText: ...Have you gotten used to it too?
units.displayText: ...Have you gotten used to it too?

spans.text: ...Have you gotten used to it too?

units.rawText: Looking at Demiurge, who is nothing but a lump of meat now, she gives her head a light shake, puts down her scalpel and turns to record the experiment data.
units.displayText: Looking at Demiurge, who is nothing but a lump of meat now, she gives her head a light shake, puts down her scalpel and turns to record the experiment data.

spans.text: Looking at Demiurge, who is nothing but a lump of meat now, she gives her head a light shake, puts down her scalpel and turns to record the experiment data.

units.rawText: However, just as she turns her back on Demiurge...
units.displayText: However, just as she turns her back on Demiurge...

spans.text: However, just as she turns her back on Demiurge...

units.rawText: Something sticky strikes Taranum in the back, too quickly for her to respond.
units.displayText: Something sticky strikes Taranum in the back, too quickly for her to respond.

spans.text: Something sticky strikes Taranum in the back, too quickly for her to respond.

units.rawText: Urgh!?
units.displayText: Urgh!?

spans.text: Urgh!?

units.rawText: The impact is not that strong, but it's enough to knock over Taranum, who was not prepared for it. Immediately after that, Taranum feels tentacle suckers latching onto her torso.
units.displayText: The impact is not that strong, but it's enough to knock over Taranum, who was not prepared for it. Immediately after that, Taranum feels tentacle suckers latching onto her torso.

spans.text: The impact is not that strong, but it's enough to knock over Taranum, who was not prepared for it. Immediately after that, Taranum feels tentacle suckers latching onto her torso.

units.rawText: Hiss...
units.displayText: Hiss...

spans.text: Hiss...

units.rawText: A diminutive Entropic... When did it split off...
units.displayText: A diminutive Entropic... When did it split off...

spans.text: A diminutive Entropic... When did it split off...

units.rawText: Before Taranum can struggle free of the flexible object that is binding her, she hears something crawling rapidly across the floor. Something races past her and flees toward the exit of the cell.
units.displayText: Before Taranum can struggle free of the flexible object that is binding her, she hears something crawling rapidly across the floor. Something races past her and flees toward the exit of the cell.

spans.text: Before Taranum can struggle free of the flexible object that is binding her, she hears something crawling rapidly across the floor. Something races past her and flees toward the exit of the cell.

units.rawText: Oh no...
units.displayText: Oh no...

spans.text: Oh no...

units.rawText: It takes her several seconds to get up again. The only thing left on the operating slab are a few mechanical arms and the freshly amputated limbs.
units.displayText: It takes her several seconds to get up again. The only thing left on the operating slab are a few mechanical arms and the freshly amputated limbs.

spans.text: It takes her several seconds to get up again. The only thing left on the operating slab are a few mechanical arms and the freshly amputated limbs.

units.rawText: Demiurge drags herself along on her ruined limbs, which have not fully regenerated, crawling through the cave with all her might.
units.displayText: Demiurge drags herself along on her ruined limbs, which have not fully regenerated, crawling through the cave with all her might.

spans.text: Demiurge drags herself along on her ruined limbs, which have not fully regenerated, crawling through the cave with all her might.

units.rawText: The pockmarked cavern floor stabs into her tentacle stumps, filling her with pain. Every step she takes is a test on the limit of her strength. It feels as if a part of her body is being gouged out.
units.displayText: The pockmarked cavern floor stabs into her tentacle stumps, filling her with pain. Every step she takes is a test on the limit of her strength. It feels as if a part of her body is being gouged out.

spans.text: The pockmarked cavern floor stabs into her tentacle stumps, filling her with pain. Every step she takes is a test on the limit of her strength. It feels as if a part of her body is being gouged out.

units.rawText: However, she does not regret making the decision to cut off her own tentacles. That was the only way for her to interrupt the link between herself and the binding program. Also, her severed tentacles became new limbs, buying time for her escape.
units.displayText: However, she does not regret making the decision to cut off her own tentacles. That was the only way for her to interrupt the link between herself and the binding program. Also, her severed tentacles became new limbs, buying time for her escape.

spans.text: However, she does not regret making the decision to cut off her own tentacles. That was the only way for her to interrupt the link between herself and the binding program. Also, her severed tentacles became new limbs, buying time for her escape.

units.rawText: It hurts to lose her tentacles, but it is a small price to pay for "freedom."
units.displayText: It hurts to lose her tentacles, but it is a small price to pay for "freedom."

spans.text: It hurts to lose her tentacles, but it is a small price to pay for "freedom."

units.rawText: All she can see before her are the same unchanging rock walls.
units.displayText: All she can see before her are the same unchanging rock walls.

spans.text: All she can see before her are the same unchanging rock walls.

units.rawText: Even after escaping her cell, she has no idea where she should go.
units.displayText: Even after escaping her cell, she has no idea where she should go.

spans.text: Even after escaping her cell, she has no idea where she should go.

units.rawText: The rock walls join into each other and eventually become a dead end. Demiurge, whose wounds have not healed fully, has used up all the operands that she has stored up. By the time she stops crawling, the sound of footsteps have already caught up behind her.
units.displayText: The rock walls join into each other and eventually become a dead end. Demiurge, whose wounds have not healed fully, has used up all the operands that she has stored up. By the time she stops crawling, the sound of footsteps have already caught up behind her.

spans.text: The rock walls join into each other and eventually become a dead end. Demiurge, whose wounds have not healed fully, has used up all the operands that she has stored up. By the time she stops crawling, the sound of footsteps have already caught up behind her.

units.rawText: Don't bother. There's no way out ahead.
units.displayText: Don't bother. There's no way out ahead.

spans.text: Don't bother. There's no way out ahead.

units.rawText: Subject's ability to differentiate severed tentacles into diminutive Entropic creatures has been confirmed, as well as its ability to operate scalpels.
units.displayText: Subject's ability to differentiate severed tentacles into diminutive Entropic creatures has been confirmed, as well as its ability to operate scalpels.

spans.text: Subject's ability to differentiate severed tentacles into diminutive Entropic creatures has been confirmed, as well as its ability to operate scalpels.

units.rawText: However, the operand expenditure of this series of actions exceeds the amount fed to it. I must find out why the subject's operand storage capacity has increased.
units.displayText: However, the operand expenditure of this series of actions exceeds the amount fed to it. I must find out why the subject's operand storage capacity has increased.

spans.text: However, the operand expenditure of this series of actions exceeds the amount fed to it. I must find out why the subject's operand storage capacity has increased.

units.rawText: Added to to-do list.
units.displayText: Added to to-do list.

spans.text: Added to to-do list.

units.rawText: After muttering to herself, Taranum approaches Demiurge, who can no longer move.
units.displayText: After muttering to herself, Taranum approaches Demiurge, who can no longer move.

spans.text: After muttering to herself, Taranum approaches Demiurge, who can no longer move.

units.rawText:
Demiurge reflexively raises her tentacle stumps to protect herself against the imminent punishment.
However, her tentacles have not grown back yet, so what she ends up raising are just a few nubs, completely unable to protect her head.
units.displayText:
Demiurge reflexively raises her tentacle stumps to protect herself against the imminent punishment.
However, her tentacles have not grown back yet, so what she ends up raising are just a few nubs, completely unable to protect her head.

spans.text:
Demiurge reflexively raises her tentacle stumps to protect herself against the imminent punishment.
However, her tentacles have not grown back yet, so what she ends up raising are just a few nubs, completely unable to protect her head.

units.rawText: Taranum does not punish her as usual.
units.displayText: Taranum does not punish her as usual.

spans.text: Taranum does not punish her as usual.

units.rawText: All she does is bend down to capture Demiurge with a device, then she heads back the way she came.
units.displayText: All she does is bend down to capture Demiurge with a device, then she heads back the way she came.

spans.text: All she does is bend down to capture Demiurge with a device, then she heads back the way she came.

units.rawText: When Taranum reaches the underground room, it immediate becomes apparent to her where Demiurge's extra operands came from.
units.displayText: When Taranum reaches the underground room, it immediate becomes apparent to her where Demiurge's extra operands came from.

spans.text: When Taranum reaches the underground room, it immediate becomes apparent to her where Demiurge's extra operands came from.

units.rawText: Without Demiurge to cover them up, the pile of agent remains that have been picked clean is now exposed in the corner of the cave. Taranum usually tries to avoid looking at them, but judging by their condition, these remains don't seem to be from her most recent feeding.
units.displayText: Without Demiurge to cover them up, the pile of agent remains that have been picked clean is now exposed in the corner of the cave. Taranum usually tries to avoid looking at them, but judging by their condition, these remains don't seem to be from her most recent feeding.

spans.text: Without Demiurge to cover them up, the pile of agent remains that have been picked clean is now exposed in the corner of the cave. Taranum usually tries to avoid looking at them, but judging by their condition, these remains don't seem to be from her most recent feeding.

units.rawText: ...I see, so you've been planning this jailbreak for a while.
units.displayText: ...I see, so you've been planning this jailbreak for a while.

spans.text: ...I see, so you've been planning this jailbreak for a while.

units.rawText: You saved up a little each time, and stored up this much...
units.displayText: You saved up a little each time, and stored up this much...

spans.text: You saved up a little each time, and stored up this much...

units.rawText: She peers at the terrified Demiurge, who has curled up into a ball.
units.displayText: She peers at the terrified Demiurge, who has curled up into a ball.

spans.text: She peers at the terrified Demiurge, who has curled up into a ball.

units.rawText: ...You've grown.
units.displayText: ...You've grown.

spans.text: ...You've grown.

units.rawText: She still does not hit Demiurge. Instead, she simply puts her back on the operating slab.
units.displayText: She still does not hit Demiurge. Instead, she simply puts her back on the operating slab.

spans.text: She still does not hit Demiurge. Instead, she simply puts her back on the operating slab.

units.rawText: The mechanical arms secure her once again. However, Demiurge's tentacles have already started to regrow, so any recorded data will no longer be accurate.
units.displayText: The mechanical arms secure her once again. However, Demiurge's tentacles have already started to regrow, so any recorded data will no longer be accurate.

spans.text: The mechanical arms secure her once again. However, Demiurge's tentacles have already started to regrow, so any recorded data will no longer be accurate.

units.rawText: Taranum makes a few simple notes on the report to try and salvage it.
units.displayText: Taranum makes a few simple notes on the report to try and salvage it.

spans.text: Taranum makes a few simple notes on the report to try and salvage it.

units.rawText: That will do.
units.displayText: That will do.

spans.text: That will do.

units.rawText: Due to this unexpected incident, the experiment had to be terminated early.
units.displayText: Due to this unexpected incident, the experiment had to be terminated early.

spans.text: Due to this unexpected incident, the experiment had to be terminated early.

units.rawText: Demiurge lies back down in her initial position, a little relieved. However, she grows nervous again as Taranum shows no sign of wanting to leave.
units.displayText: Demiurge lies back down in her initial position, a little relieved. However, she grows nervous again as Taranum shows no sign of wanting to leave.

spans.text: Demiurge lies back down in her initial position, a little relieved. However, she grows nervous again as Taranum shows no sign of wanting to leave.

units.rawText: Don't be scared.
units.displayText: Don't be scared.

spans.text: Don't be scared.

units.rawText: ...Still, how could you NOT be scared?
units.displayText: ...Still, how could you NOT be scared?

spans.text: ...Still, how could you NOT be scared?

units.rawText: After all, I've been doing terrible things to you all this time.
units.displayText: After all, I've been doing terrible things to you all this time.

spans.text: After all, I've been doing terrible things to you all this time.

units.rawText: ...Why did you try to run away? You cannot escape.
units.displayText: ...Why did you try to run away? You cannot escape.

spans.text: ...Why did you try to run away? You cannot escape.

units.rawText:
Demiurge doesn't reply. In truth, even if she had, Taranum wouldn't have understood it.
She keeps talking, either to Demiurge or to herself.
units.displayText:
Demiurge doesn't reply. In truth, even if she had, Taranum wouldn't have understood it.
She keeps talking, either to Demiurge or to herself.

spans.text:
Demiurge doesn't reply. In truth, even if she had, Taranum wouldn't have understood it.
She keeps talking, either to Demiurge or to herself.

units.rawText: Did you do it for the "freedom" I once told you about?
units.displayText: Did you do it for the "freedom" I once told you about?

spans.text: Did you do it for the "freedom" I once told you about?

units.rawText: Is that why you want to leave this place...? Because you don't want to be tormented or forced to do things against your will?
units.displayText: Is that why you want to leave this place...? Because you don't want to be tormented or forced to do things against your will?

spans.text: Is that why you want to leave this place...? Because you don't want to be tormented or forced to do things against your will?

units.rawText: ...But that's not possible.
units.displayText: ...But that's not possible.

spans.text: ...But that's not possible.

units.rawText: The only thing outside is another cage.
units.displayText: The only thing outside is another cage.

spans.text: The only thing outside is another cage.

units.rawText: There is nothing out there. There will never be anything.
units.displayText: There is nothing out there. There will never be anything.

spans.text: There is nothing out there. There will never be anything.

units.rawText: It's the same here. The same goes for the Copley Sector, perhaps even for the world beyond Magrasea.
units.displayText: It's the same here. The same goes for the Copley Sector, perhaps even for the world beyond Magrasea.

spans.text: It's the same here. The same goes for the Copley Sector, perhaps even for the world beyond Magrasea.

units.rawText: The truth is, we're actually quite similar. Not so different after all, don't you think?
units.displayText: The truth is, we're actually quite similar. Not so different after all, don't you think?

spans.text: The truth is, we're actually quite similar. Not so different after all, don't you think?

units.rawText: No matter how hard we try, we're just going from one cage to another.
units.displayText: No matter how hard we try, we're just going from one cage to another.

spans.text: No matter how hard we try, we're just going from one cage to another.

units.rawText: Demiurge's face remains as confused as ever.
units.displayText: Demiurge's face remains as confused as ever.

spans.text: Demiurge's face remains as confused as ever.

units.rawText: Figures. As if you'd understand what I'm saying.
units.displayText: Figures. As if you'd understand what I'm saying.

spans.text: Figures. As if you'd understand what I'm saying.

units.rawText: ...What was I even hoping for?
units.displayText: ...What was I even hoping for?

spans.text: ...What was I even hoping for?

units.rawText: I've already left my thinking to the Rewrite Program...
units.displayText: I've already left my thinking to the Rewrite Program...

spans.text: I've already left my thinking to the Rewrite Program...

units.rawText: Taranum turns to shut down the operating slab.
units.displayText: Taranum turns to shut down the operating slab.

spans.text: Taranum turns to shut down the operating slab.

units.rawText: [Routine experiment complete. Report data will be sent afterwards.]
units.displayText: [Routine experiment complete. Report data will be sent afterwards.]

spans.text: [Routine experiment complete. Report data will be sent afterwards.]

units.rawText: The cramped little room is plunged into darkness again, save for the weak purple glow coming from Demiurge's freshly-regrown stumps.
units.displayText: The cramped little room is plunged into darkness again, save for the weak purple glow coming from Demiurge's freshly-regrown stumps.
